title: Create src/lib/caffeinate.ts — macOS sleep prevention
description: Create a module that prevents macOS from sleeping during long AI loop sessions by running caffeinate -i. On Linux, returns null without error. Provides start and stop functions.
acceptanceCriteria: start() returns null on Linux without throwing an error
On macOS, start() returns a running ChildProcess

steps.details: Create the file. Import spawn from child_process. Import ChildProcess type.
export function start(): ChildProcess | null { if (process.platform !== 'darwin') return null; return spawn('caffeinate', ['-i'], { stdio: 'ignore', detached: false }) }
export function stop(proc: ChildProcess | null): void { if (proc === null) return; try { proc.kill('SIGTERM') } catch { /* process already exited */ } }

technicalNotes: caffeinate -i prevents sleep while the caffeinate process is running — it exits automatically when its parent process dies
Use stdio: 'ignore' to prevent caffeinate from inheriting the CLI's stdio streams
On CI/Linux environments, this gracefully returns null — no code changes needed for portability
